author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be a pretty unexpected win. Backlash has driven Google to providing Android users with the ability to install whatever they want, after a 24-hour period. It's not ideal but it's a lot better than what was initially presented. How does it work exactly? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: So Google Finally Responded...
